notes.title: Dev Diary #3 💎 Auction, Gambling & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋
We've been busy behind the scenes, and it's time to show you what we've been working on! From cozy homes and high-stakes auctions to a brand-new casino and smarter NPCs, this update brings the world to life in new ways. Let’s dive in! 🛠️✨

🏡 You've Got a Home Now
To end your day, you now need to head home and get some sleep. If you want to cut down your commute, you can even buy the house right by the outlet entrance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/ec6f62858aeee89e7d9cc6fc104c7da4499073f7.gif

🛎️ The Auction Heats Up
Auctions take place every Wednesday and Sunday at 3 PM. You can join in anytime and place your bids. Each session presents three random items—no fakes, no damages.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/e3b26d82c4f588b37430c39d7064c033d8635a9e.gif

♦️ The Casino Is Open
Ready to test your luck? Just take the elevator to the second floor of the auction building. The casino features three games: Blackjack, Slots, and Roulette.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/f71b38d8fb0ab879d031efa5a744ebfae682bb6e.gif

Whether you're looking to earn some quick cash or just have fun, this is the place to be. But remember—luck can be a double-edged sword 😄
🎰Slot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/fc8f9575bfac922cd67473bf7845ee1edbb9e279.gif

🪙Roulette
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/ed39335b4481207de4f4fa6961250baa64add8d9.gif

🃏Blackjack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/df55f6ef1c6be3442d65a0ee322a408ecd442c4c.gif

🌆 Open World Improvements
We replaced the golf course with a park! Now there’s a peaceful green space in the middle of the city for you to relax in.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/7ccc7e2678ed0659342b4240a3aba4281f0ced64.gif

NPC behavior has been completely overhauled. No more walking through walls—they're now much more active: queuing at the bank, gambling at the casino, checking out cars at the dealership.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/606783961368ccc855aa5cc4a1bb549de86480ee.png

That’s all from us for now—don’t forget to share your thoughts with us!
See you in the next dev diary!

Ps. Don't forget to Follow & Wishlist the Prologue!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948930/Jeweler_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 💎 Jewelry Crafting & More!
notes.content:
Hello jewelers!

It’s been over a month since our last update, and we’ve been working hard to bring exciting new features to Jeweler Simulator. This dev diary covers some major additions, including jewelry crafting, cleaning improvements, new sounds and UI animations, and expanded product box variety. Let’s dive in!

💎Jewelry Crafting: Create Your Own Masterpieces
Jewelry crafting is now a core feature, giving players full control over the design process. Here’s how it works:

🔹 Gem Cutting – Obtain raw gemstones and shape them into beautiful, precise cuts. Your craftsmanship directly impacts the gem’s final quality.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/9740b6ad82eae0b96d581ed809a3ed9f72987284.gif
🔹 Body Selection – Visit the pawn shop to purchase different ring bodies. Each one offers unique materials and designs to match your creative vision.

🔹 Assembly – With a refined gem and a ring body in hand, head to your workbench. Carefully set the gem into the ring body and finalize your custom piece!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/d9214c7f0a58507237aac9c10aa4bf26b3f43f9d.gif
This system allows for limitless creativity, making each jewelry piece truly unique.

Cleaning Improvements: Keep Your Store Spotless
A well-maintained store is key to attracting customers, and we’ve added new mechanics to emphasize cleanliness.

🧼 Footprints – Customers now leave footprints as they walk, meaning you’ll need to grab your broom and clean up after them.

🗑 More Trash Types – We’ve expanded the variety of trash that can appear in your store. Keeping the shop clean will improve your prestige, while neglecting it may drive customers away. After all, no one wants to shop in a dirty jewelry store!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/032029ed4689e9c83e1db7d58982dab9f70a3acb.gif

Sounds & UI Animations
We’ve made major audio and UI improvements to enhance immersion and responsiveness.

Sound Additions
🎵 Footstep sounds now vary depending on the surface.
🗣️ Customers now have voice lines.
🚗 Vehicles outside generate ambient noise.
🧹 Mop sounds play when cleaning.
🌙 Smooth transitions between day and night ambient sounds.
📱 New sound effects for opening and closing the tablet.
🔪 Cutting sounds for gem shaping have been added.

UI Enhancements
📜 Product Info and Sale Listing menus now slide in from the left.
🔴 Customer Requests with missing or incorrect items now pulse red, similar to fake products.
💬 Dialogue Widget now slides in from the right.
✅ Checkmarks for completed tests now appear with an ease-in animation.
📊 Damage & Clarity test bars now rise from the bottom, fill up, and retract smoothly.
🌘 End-of-day and Prestige Level-Up screens now fade to black before displaying elements with a dissolve effect.
📖 Tutorials spanning multiple pages now transition smoothly instead of abruptly switching.

These updates make interactions feel smoother and more polished!

Expanded Product Box Variety
Until now, jewelry boxes were mostly the same, but that’s changing! We’ve increased the variety of product boxes to add more realism and customization.

💍 8 ring boxes
📿 6 necklace boxes
⛏ 4 ore boxes

This means more options for presenting and storing jewelry, making each item feel more distinct.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/b0ec46ad888fceafb6d713d41bbf14c795bbda07.gif


That’s it for this update! These new mechanics and refinements bring Jeweler Simulator closer to a fully immersive experience, and we’re excited to share more in the coming months. Thanks for following our journey, and see you in the next dev diary!

Ps. Don't forget to Follow & Wishlist the Prologue!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948930/Jeweler_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 🏚️ Shop Expansion & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve been hard at work bringing some big improvements to the game, and we’re excited to share them with you. This update adds new ways to customize your shop, expands the city, and even introduces a familiar face who might stop by for a little help.

There’s a lot to cover, so let’s jump right in!

👴🏼Homeless NPCs
A homeless man will knock on your shop’s window, asking for help. You can give him some money, politely refuse, or turn him away. If you decide to help, he’ll return the next day with a small gift. Not worth much, but what did you expect? Keep an eye out, he might visit again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/86611d9729b249a7e19eb2b4ec773ad1e97b6f55.gif

🎨Store Upgrades & Customization
Time to make your shop truly yours! Head to the My Business app on your tablet and check out the Store Upgrade tab. You’ll be able to expand your shop step by step.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/0635ac490315f9b23f7d7cfecee59ec735b1f024.gif

Customization has arrived! 🏗️ Give your shop a personal touch by changing the flooring, walls, and ceiling to match your style. 🏠✨ Right now, you’ve got 12 floor styles, 9 wall designs, and 9 ceiling textures to choose from—with even more on the way in future updates! 🚀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/7ebb2c4b6a61005fbb13eddc1945f06a500c8f39.gif

🌎A More Realistic World

 The city is expanding! More buildings, more variety, and a greater sense of depth.
 The outskirts have gotten a makeover, making the environment feel richer.
 Lighting adjustments help bring the world to life, making every moment more immersive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/d02cfeaf97569b836cf9dd37745da6ac86af01ae.png

🛋️New Furnitures & Decorations
Tons of new furniture options, including:

 Counters (now 13 designs instead of 2!)
 Showcases (up from 3 to 12!)
 Storage cabinets (now 8 choices!)
 Decor items like plants, paintings, and a working wall clock.
 And yes—customers can now sit in chairs, making your shop feel more alive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/6aadaa125657336d3a1f57c2676d2af01cb4ad97.png

📩Email System
Your tablet now has a Mail app to keep you informed! Here’s what you’ll be notified about:

 Loan reminders & automatic payments
 Fake item penalties (watch out!)
 Pawn deadlines so you don’t miss out on deals
 Repair completion alerts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/fc4e6d6b15b0d074fc62e7c15dff7aee060d4822.gif

💰 Pawn Shop – Quick Cash, High Stakes!
Need some quick cash? 🏦 The pawn shop has you covered! Leave your items there for a temporary payout 💵, but don’t wait too long—you’ve got just 5 days ⏳ to buy them back. Miss the deadline, and they’re gone for good! ❌ Plan your moves carefully! 🧠

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/ec3841002c4ed08c4866a825f3d7b22b7b09c045.gif

🛠️ Repair Shop
Customers won’t be keen on damaged goods, so some items will need a little TLC. 🏚️➡️✨ Send them in for repairs—it’ll take a few days 🕰️, but once they’re fixed up, they’ll be back on the shelves, ready to sell! 🏪 Restored items not only look better but also fetch a higher price 💰 and attract more buyers! 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897619/c117d2d42b6c616b5f141343800a49c13f02bc98.gif

That’s it for this update! Let us know what you think and we’re super excited to show you more!

Ps. Don't forget to Follow & Wishlist the Prologue!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948930/Jeweler_Simulator_Prologue/
